_comment: Budget for `npm run test:perf`. `gates` fails the build; `reference` is printed for a human and does not. Both gated metrics are counts, so both are machine-independent: `fileCount` caps the total, and `jsdomFileCount` caps the subset that pays ~106ms of jsdom construction per file (ADR: isolated/node 40ms vs isolated/jsdom 147ms per file, environment 81% of the jsdom figure). The JSON reporter cannot measure fixed cost — both time columns cover the test phase only — so wall is the sole figure that includes it and wall is machine- and worker-count-dependent (76.9s at 6 workers, 184s at 3, 303s at 2 on one 8-core box). Raising a gate requires an ADR note recording the trajectory and the cause, because a bare raise only resets the clock: 930 was sized as the 2026-09-26 count (910) plus 20, the suite crossed it the next day, and it reached 1059 by 2026-10-12. See dev-docs/ADR/2026-09-26-test-suite-execution-time-contract.md (R4).
